dietary_recommendation: Focus on low glycemic index foods, high fiber, and consistent carbohydrate intake throughout the day. Include lean proteins and healthy fats.
foods_to_avoid: Sugary foods, white bread, white rice, pastries, sweetened beverages, fruit juices

dietary_recommendation: Follow a DASH diet with reduced sodium, increased potassium, calcium, and magnesium. Include fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins.
foods_to_avoid: High sodium foods, processed meats, canned soups, pickled foods, salty snacks

dietary_recommendation: Choose heart-healthy foods low in saturated and trans fats. Emphasize fruits, vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, and foods rich in omega-3 fatty acids.
foods_to_avoid: Fried foods, fatty meats, full-fat dairy, baked goods with trans fats, excessive salt

dietary_recommendation: Focus on portion control and nutrient-dense foods with lower calorie density. Increase protein and fiber intake for satiety.
foods_to_avoid: Sugary beverages, processed foods, high-calorie desserts, fried foods, refined carbohydrates

dietary_recommendation: Eat smaller, more frequent meals. Focus on alkaline foods and avoid eating close to bedtime.
foods_to_avoid: Citrus fruits, tomatoes, spicy foods, fatty foods, chocolate, caffeine, alcohol

dietary_recommendation: Follow a low FODMAP diet if recommended by your healthcare provider. Stay hydrated and eat regular meals.
foods_to_avoid: High FODMAP foods (varies by individual), very fatty foods, excessive caffeine, alcohol

dietary_recommendation: Consume adequate calcium and vitamin D. Include protein and magnesium-rich foods.
foods_to_avoid: Excessive salt, caffeine, and alcohol can interfere with calcium absorption

dietary_recommendation: Focus on iron-rich foods paired with vitamin C for better absorption. Include vitamin B12 and folate sources.
foods_to_avoid: Foods that inhibit iron absorption when eaten with iron sources (tea, coffee, dairy)

dietary_recommendation: Strictly avoid allergens and be vigilant about cross-contamination. Focus on nutritious alternatives.
foods_to_avoid: Specific allergens (nuts, shellfish, dairy, eggs, etc. as relevant to the individual)

dietary_recommendation: Follow a strict gluten-free diet. Focus on naturally gluten-free grains like rice and quinoa.
foods_to_avoid: All sources of gluten: wheat, barley, rye, and foods cross-contaminated with these grains
